entries.name: Millbrook
entries.description: A village of forty households where the drovers' road fords the Mill Brook.

entries.name: The Old Mill
entries.description: The Brask family's watermill on the brook, the oldest building in the village after the chapel.

entries.name: Millbrook Chapel
entries.description: A squat stone chapel with a square bell tower. Its bell was cast in the undercroft beneath it.

entries.name: Wenna Brask
entries.description: The miller, widowed young, who runs the mill with her son.

entries.name: The Bell-Founders
entries.description: The guild that cast Millbrook's bell in the undercroft and buried its dead in a crypt beneath the chapel.

links.note: They built it, and cast its bell.
